description: This file defines the SuiteEditorTinyMCE class, which implements the SuiteEditorInterface to integrate the TinyMCE rich text editor within the SuiteCRM application. It includes setup and HTML rendering methods, utilizing Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: SuiteEditorTinyMCE
classes.description: Implements SuiteEditorInterface to embed TinyMCE editor as SuiteEditor.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the editor with optional settings.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Renders the HTML for the TinyMCE editor using Smarty template.
